$comment: NON-BREAKING metadata backfill for the Dasha Compute MCP tool catalog. Implements V4 (2026-07-28 `title`) and V5 (keyword-rich descriptions) of PR #228 (docs/MCP-TOOL-NAMING-AUDIT.md). Tool `name`s are intentionally UNCHANGED — renames are breaking changes (unknown name -> JSON-RPC -32602) scheduled for the Worker lane owner under the GAP-8 legacy-posture decision. Worker lane: merge `title` + `description` into the live mcp.json served at https://www.getdasha.com/compute/mcp.json; update skill.md prose and the mcpservers.org listing body to match.

tools.description: Dasha Compute coordinator health check. Confirms the inference coordinator is reachable before routing LLM chat completions to community Apple Silicon Macs.
tools.name: healthz
tools.title: Dasha coordinator health

tools.description: OpenAI-compatible LLM model list for the Dasha Mac inference network. Available models include qwen3-8b, gemma3-12b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-30b-a3b, gemma3-27b, gpt-oss-120b, with per-model pricing — use this to pick a model before calling chat completions.
tools.name: models
tools.title: Dasha models list

tools.description: Live view of community Macs advertising inference capacity on the Dasha network — which provider Macs are online, what LLM models they serve, and current availability.
tools.name: network
tools.title: Dasha Mac network

tools.description: Mint a free 24-hour guest API key for auth with the Dasha chat completions and models endpoints. Copy the key once — it cannot be retrieved later. Rate-limited to 3 keys per hour per IP.
tools.name: guest-keys
tools.title: Mint Dasha guest key

tools.description: Run an OpenAI-compatible chat completion as inference on a Dasha community Mac. Point the OpenAI SDK base_url at the Dasha API and pass a Bearer API key. Available models include qwen3-8b, gemma3-12b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-30b-a3b, gemma3-27b, gpt-oss-120b. Fails loudly with no_mac_online if no Mac advertises the requested model — never silently.
tools.name: chat.completions
tools.title: Dasha chat completions
